title.ja: 独自の AI を作る

goals.summary: Run a local model, give it a memory that survives restarts, and let it act on its own between your messages.

steps.why: Start local. Nothing leaves the machine while you are still deciding what this assistant is for.
Pick the model that will do the thinking. This is the one choice that changes how it feels more than any other.
Point at where Ollama is running. Default is fine unless you moved it.
Turn on memory. Without this the assistant starts from nothing every session, which is the difference between a chat window and something that is yours.
Say what it is for. This text goes in front of every request and is what makes it your assistant rather than a generic one.
Let it keep working between your messages instead of stopping after each reply.
While you are still shaping it, have it ask rather than guess. Switch to Automatic once you trust it.

title.ja: すべてこの端末だけで使う

goals.summary: No text leaves the machine, at any point, for any reason.

steps.why: The switch that actually decides it. Everything below is defence in depth.
A local model has to do the work now, so this choice is no longer optional.
Stop the commander model from reaching for a cloud model.
Local memory replaces what the cloud's long context was doing for you.

title.en: Use the cloud without shipping your names

steps.why: Masks identifiers on the way out. Paranoia Mode is the stricter version if this is not enough.
The masking pass itself.
A cloud provider needs a key. Type it in the GUI — it is never printed back, and nothing else can enter it for you.
Which provider the masked request goes to.

title.en: Run a large model across two Macs
title.ja: 2台の Mac で大きいモデルを動かす

goals.summary: Split a model that does not fit in one machine's memory across a Thunderbolt link.

steps.why: Distributed inference is a local arrangement; the cloud routes do not apply.
Set this deliberately. Splitting a model makes it easy to ask for a context neither half can hold.
The commander reads across the link, so shallow memory costs more here than it saves.

title.ja: 共有コードで安全に作業する

goals.summary: Nothing lands without passing a review gate first.

steps.why: Every change passes the gate. This is the whole recipe; the rest is making the gate informative.
Turns the gate on.
Review what went into memory in bulk. Per-turn approval stops the agent constantly, and prompts that interrupt constantly stop being read.
See changes as diffs before they land.
